verdict.rationale: Steel documents an official Steel CLI that runs end-to-end browser workflows from the terminal: start a session, navigate, click/fill/type, extract content and stop the session. The docs also tell users to install the CLI alongside the steel-browser skill so an agent can drive a browser, and a probe confirms the official CLI docs page exists. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the CLI.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI

citations.quote: The Steel CLI lets you run full browser workflows from the terminal, end-to-end. You can start a browser session, navigate pages, click/fill/type, extract content, and stop the session
Install Steel CLI and the steel-browser skill so your agent can control a browser.
